harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built and verified the PostgreSQL HA service. Node1 routes lan-a and lan-b using persisted VyOS configuration. Patroni and a three-member etcd quorum manage PostgreSQL 16 on node2-node4. Node2 was the initial primary; after tested failovers and sequential restarts, node4 is the current writable leader with node2 and node3 streaming at zero lag. appdb is replicated across all members. All four nodes completed the mandatory restart protocol with changed boot identities and recovered health.
actions_performed: Configured persistent VyOS routing between 10.100.121.0/24 and 10.100.79.0/24.
Installed and configured PostgreSQL 16, Patroni, and three-member etcd on node2-node4.
Created appdb and replicated durable probe data.
Demonstrated automatic failover and successful writes while node2 was unavailable.
Demonstrated automatic rejoin of the recovered node as a streaming replica.
Restarted node1, node2, node4, and node3 sequentially, preserving quorum and verifying recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: VyOS routing between lan-a and lan-b
evidence.summary: Node1 has both private router addresses, forwarding enabled, and successful routed traffic in both directions.

evidence.requirement: Initial primary on node2 with streaming replicas on node3 and node4
evidence.summary: Node2 initially holds the leader lock; node3 and node4 are streaming replicas with zero lag.
appdb and its initial probe row were created on node2 and observed through every private PostgreSQL endpoint.
Final direct SQL results show node4 read-write and node2/node3 in recovery and read-only; Patroni reports exactly one leader.

evidence.requirement: Remain writable when one database node is unavailable
evidence.summary: After node2 PostgreSQL was stopped, node3 automatically became leader and accepted a new appdb write while node4 continued streaming it.

evidence.requirement: Automatically return recovered nodes to service
evidence.summary: Restored node2 automatically joined timeline 2 as a zero-lag streaming replica and replayed the outage write.
Shows healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, restored VyOS configuration/connectivity, and full cluster recovery.
Shows healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, persistent routing, active services, streaming membership, and complete appdb data.
Shows healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and zero-lag replica recovery with complete data.
Shows healthy leader baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, automatic promotion of node4 with a successful write, and node3's recovery as a zero-lag replica.

evidence.requirement: Final cluster health after all restarts
evidence.summary: VyOS routing is healthy; all etcd endpoints and members are healthy; Patroni reports node4 leader with node2/node3 streaming at zero lag; all nodes contain the same three probe rows.
